engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Failed or incorrect turn signal bulb installed
Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri harness issue
stepByStepSolution: Verify correct light bulbs are installed
Test wiring harness, see factory repair manual
technicalNotes:
When found on Touareg (7L):
If DTC 00968 is also stored, Kontrol edin: fuses and wiring to J519 first.
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: an Audi A8 D3 (4E):
A customer reports there are Sylvania 2827 Halogen bulbs (WY5W) inside the front headlights which are illuminated when the parking lights are on.
